The edit profile screen is complete: `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

- **Photo**: an `Avatar` preview beside a `FileUpload` control to pick a new PNG/JPEG.
- **Fields**: Full name, Email, Phone, Date of birth (`DatePicker`), Preferred language (`Select`), all controlled against mock saved data.
- **Change tracking**: each field's label shows a "Changed" status badge when its draft value differs from the last-saved value; a summary line in the footer states how many fields changed.
- **Actions**: Cancel (reverts to last save) and Save changes (both disabled when nothing changed); saving shows a success toast ("Profile updated").
- Built only from `@syntara/react`/`@syntara/icons`-adjacent components, tokens-only CSS, logical properties, and an `ltrValue` class keeping email/phone LTR under the Arabic locale. Audited at 100/100 for both files.

I can't run the app to visually verify — this was reviewed via the design-system audit tool and against the component docs, not in a browser.
